settings.diagNote: Shows an on-screen panel with what the browser reports for each touch, pen or mouse pointer (type, contact size, pressure). Useful to find out whether a device can tell a stylus, a finger and a palm apart.
diag.title: Touch diagnostics
diag.stats: Totals by pointer type (n = presses, w/h = contact size in px, pmax = highest pressure)
settings.palmNote: Ignores a hand resting on the screen while you use a stylus. A second finger must land within the window of the first, so pinching still works; a much smaller late touch means the first was a palm. A slow pinch may be ignored.
scaledlg.sharpNote: Normal and Strong keep text and thin lines crisper when the image is reduced. They have no effect when it is enlarged.
